taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-12 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1228.3 | 0.41 | 0.41
2 | 678.3 | 0.50 | 0.91
3 | 2104.5 | 0.76 | 1.67
4 | 3417.4 | 29.87 | 31.54
5 | 3516.3 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-12
Curve type: H-type
Aquifer depth: 1.67 – 31.54 m
Recommendation: The thick, high-resistivity layer between ~1.7 m and 31.5 m likely represents a fractured/weathered bedrock zone with groundwater potential; drill through this interval with care to log lithology changes, and plan casing/screen placement to isolate it from the shallow low-resistivity layers (0–1.67 m) and confirm productive fracturing before deepening into the resistive basement below 31.5 m.
